To

All Regional Provident Fund Commissioners
Regional Offices & Sub Regional Offices

Subject: Social Security Agreement with Germany, Requests for certain statistics
Sir,

It is informed that the Ministry of External Affairs has requested the following
information urgently:-

(1) The number of the German citizens working in India from October 2009 to 31 March

2016 and who have exemptions from compliance under EPF Scheme 1952.

(2) Approximate amount of money saved (by the German citizens) in lieu of the exemption
from the payment of Social Security Contributions.

You are requested to provide the details already available by 13-04-2016 to this office by
email (rc.iwcell@epfindia.gov.in)

Yours faithfully,

(Dr.S.K. Thakur)
Additional Central PF Commissioner (IWU)

Copy to RPFC (NDC);with a request to upload the circular on EPFO Website.
